{{Quote|Those are the helpers! They do whatever Hethrir tells them to, they're even meaner than the Proctors.|[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]|<ref name="The Crystal Star">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref>}}
The lowest rank in [[Hethrir]]'s [[Empire Youth]] school, the '''Helpers''' served as attendants and servers. They wore rust-[[Color/Legends|colored]] robes.<ref name="The Crystal Star" />
